editor.swap: Swap the source and target languages of {{field}}

inline.saveFirst: Save your changes to the {{language}} text first: AI translates the saved text.
inline.done: The {{language}} translation is ready to review.
inline.off: AI is off for your organisation, so text cannot be translated automatically.
inline.unsupported: The AI provider your organisation uses cannot translate text. Translation needs an OpenAI-compatible provider.

suggestion.title: AI suggestion
suggestion.stale: The {{language}} text has changed since this was suggested. Check that it still fits before you accept it.
suggestion.glossary: Glossary terms were kept exactly as defined.
suggestion.editLabel: Edit the {{language}} suggestion for {{field}} before accepting it
suggestion.replaceBody: {{field}} already has {{language}} text. Accepting replaces it with this suggestion.
suggestion.alreadyDecided: Someone has already decided this suggestion.

panel.title: Translation suggestions
panel.hint: AI translated these fields. Nothing changes on the asset until you accept one.
panel.hintReader: AI translated these fields. An editor accepts or rejects each one.

dialog.title: Translate with AI
dialog.intro: AI writes a suggestion for each field and language. Nothing changes on the asset until you review and accept a suggestion.
dialog.sourceHint: Optional. Name the language the text is written in if the automatic choice is wrong.
dialog.targetsHint: {{count}} chosen. You can choose up to {{max}}.
dialog.overwriteHint: Without this, languages that already have text are skipped. Nothing is replaced until you accept a suggestion.
dialog.noFields: This kind of asset has no fields that hold text in several languages.
dialog.schemaFailed: Could not load this asset's fields.

job.keepWorking: You can close this and keep working; the suggestions appear on the asset when they are ready.
job.loadFailed: Could not check on the translation.

done.succeeded: Finished: {{count}} translations are ready to review.
done.partial: Finished with some problems: {{count}} translations are ready to review.
done.failed: The translation did not produce anything.

summary.title: AI-generated summary
summary.none: No summary yet. AI can write a short one from the text in this document.
summary.slow: This is taking longer than usual. The summary will appear here when it is ready.

features.summariesHint: Writes a short summary of longer documents, labelled as AI-generated and searchable. The built-in provider picks key sentences; it does not write new text.

translations.emptyBody: When AI translates an asset you can edit, it shows up here until you accept or reject its suggestions.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Terms that translation must treat with care: brand and product names, and words that have a fixed translation.
glossary.explain: A locked term is kept exactly as written in every language, so a product name is never translated. A mapped term is replaced by the rendering you give for each language. This holds whichever AI provider does the translating.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to the glossary
forbidden.description: Managing the glossary needs the glossary.manage permission. Ask an administrator.

glossary.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No glossary terms yet
empty.description: Add the names and phrases translation must never get wrong, one at a time or pasted in as a list.

mode.lockedDesc: Kept exactly as written in every language.
mode.mappedDesc: Replaced by a fixed rendering for each language you give.

glossary.limitNote: A glossary holds up to {{max}} terms.
glossary.limitReached: The glossary is full. A glossary holds up to 5,000 terms; delete some before adding more.

form.termHint: Matched exactly as written, including capital letters.
form.needRendering: A mapped term needs a rendering in at least one language.
form.rowIncomplete: Give each rendering a language and its text.
form.rowDuplicate: Each language can appear only once.
form.noteHint: Optional. Why the term is here; only editors of the glossary see it.

delete.label: Delete {{term}}
delete.title: Delete this term?
delete.body: {{term}} will no longer be protected when text is translated.
delete.note: Text that was already translated does not change.

import.title: Paste glossary terms
import.intro: One term per line. A term on its own is locked. Add | language=rendering pairs to map it.
import.example:
Acme Lumen
Acme Cloud | hi=ऐक्मे क्लाउड | ta=ஏக்மி கிளவுட்
import.label: Terms
import.languagesHint: Languages you can map: {{languages}}. Up to {{max}} lines at a time.
import.summary: {{count}} terms will be created: {{locked}} locked, {{mapped}} mapped.
import.truncated: Only the first {{max}} lines are used.
import.errors_one: {{count}} line has a problem and will be skipped
import.errors_other: {{count}} lines have problems and will be skipped

error.badSegment: "{{detail}}" is not in the form language=rendering.
error.unknownLanguage: "{{detail}}" is not a language this organisation uses.

import.limit: The glossary reached its limit of {{max}} terms. {{count}} terms were not added.
